resolutions.resolution_en: AI Project OS tools intentionally use the Python standard library and require no product dependency manifest.
resolutions.resolution_zh: AI Project OS 工具有意只使用 Python 标准库，不需要产品依赖清单。

resolutions.resolution_en: AI Project OS is a Markdown-first operating package entered through START_HERE and explicit standard-library tools, not one runtime server.
resolutions.resolution_zh: AI Project OS 是通过 START_HERE 和显式标准库工具进入的 Markdown-first 操作包，不是单一运行服务器。
